rules.text: Never add a second Pdfium instance or pass a handle across threads. PdfRenderer owns it privately.
There are two PDF paths on purpose: pdf-extract indexes text, pdfium-render rasterises pages. Do not unify them.
When changing what a runtime stop clears, enumerate every field of FolderRuntime and the watcher and clear them in one commit.
For a bug you cannot reproduce from reading the code, land a 'debug:' commit that adds tracing before attempting a fix.
One implementation unit per commit. Use the unit list in docs/plans/2026-01-15-001-feat-pdf-search-viewer-plan.md as the sequence.
[profile.release] stays as lto = true only. Do not add panic = "abort".
Put new state and event handling in the module that owns the data; let src/app.rs only dispatch.
A fix for a reoccurring failure gets a #[test] in the same commit, in the #[cfg(test)] mod tests block of the owning module.

checklist.text: Run `cargo test`; it must pass before you start.
Run `cargo build --release` with a 30s timeout if you touched Cargo.toml or thread wiring; a build that never returns has deadlocked, not crashed.
Confirm the tree is clean: `git status --porcelain`.
Read src/preview/pdf_render.rs lines 1-100 if your change is anywhere near PDF handling.
One implementation unit per commit; add a plan file in docs/plans/ for anything non-trivial.
Do not add a second Pdfium handle or a Mutex around one, and do not merge the text-extraction path with the render path.
If you add a thread, a channel, or a shutdown field, extend the runtime stop path in the same commit, enumerating every field.
Put new state in the module that owns the data. Do not add a subsystem to src/app.rs.
For a bug you cannot reproduce by reading, land a `debug:` commit with tracing first.
Run `cargo test`; every test that passed before still passes, and a reoccurring failure gains a #[test] in the owning module.
If you touched one side of a coupling pair, check the other side.
Do not edit [profile.release] beyond lto = true.
